hypothesis: The residual codebook preserves additional valid teacher views, but unconditional hard-max treats every high residual response as equally trustworthy and inflates background. A global permutation-invariant query-conditioned confidence router can use response margin, slot-to-fallback agreement and token gauge to select useful residual evidence while retaining the exact V2 fallback.

frozen_inputs.codebook_state_semantics: frozen final representation diagnostic; canonical is exact V2 and teacher-best-slot gain is +0.0084808469

router.parameterization: one shared low-capacity MLP produces each residual logit; fallback logit is fixed at zero; softmax produces a convex response mixture
router.initial_prior: 0.9 exact-fallback mass and 0.1 total residual mass, encoded only as the shared scorer bias and trainable thereafter

training.data_and_splits: same frozen 32/8 scene-disjoint caches and 806/101 query-disjoint generic text banks
training.target_response: hard maximum of official teacher-view descriptor cosine, identical for candidate and V2 control
training.loss_weighting: response fidelity is main; listwise and hard-negative gradients are each calibrated once to 0.25 of the main gradient norm
training.checkpoint_selection: first require every control-referenced response/ranking noninferiority condition, then minimize response error and maximize top1
training.seed_policy: seed0 canary first; seeds1/2 only after seed0 passes

generic_gate.control: exact frozen V2 evaluated against the identical hard-max multiview teacher
generic_gate.multiseed_requirement: mean gate passes and at least two of three seeds pass every noninferiority condition

benchmark_opening_rule.full_lerf_gate: four-scene macro improves at least 0.01 and no scene drops more than 0.01
